title: Patagonia's dry side Rising
author: Kestrel Nystrom
blurb: Elodie Okonkwo, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
